blocks.text: Sainsbury is an English surname. Notable people with the surname include:

items: Amanda Sainsbury-Salis, Australian molecular scientist, educator and author
Mark Sainsbury (broadcaster), New Zealand journalist and broadcaster
Tony Sainsbury, British chef de mission at multiple Paralympic Games
Sainsbury family, members founded Sainsbury's supermarket chain in the UK

blocks.text: The Sainsbury family founded Sainsbury's, the UK's second-largest supermarket chain. Today, the family has many interests, including business, politics, philanthropy, arts, and sciences.
